notes: Implemented the full improvement backlog. Correctness: added the missing clap `version` attribute (release smoke test ran `sample-app --version` and exit 2) and rewrote `process_items`, which silently truncated every count above 10_000. Guardrails that were previously no-ops: (1) all 15 workspace members now inherit `[lints] workspace = true`, surfacing ~71 real diagnostics that local `[lints.clippy]` allow-tables had been hiding, all fixed rather than suppressed; (2) `allow_attributes_without_reason` added because `allow_attributes` provably does not catch inner `#![allow(...)]`; (3) `cargo machete` now passes `--with-metadata`, without which workspace-inherited deps are silently assumed used — it immediately found 3 unused dev-deps; (4) `scripts/audit-msrv.sh` now fails closed and auto-installs the MSRV toolchain instead of warning-and-skipping; (5) new `Doc` check runs `cargo doc` with `RUSTDOCFLAGS=-D warnings`, catching a broken intra-doc link to a feature-gated type; (6) `arch_fitness.rs` matched zero crates (name-suffix rules matched none of them), so it now uses an explicit layer table and asserts it inspected real edges — verified it fails on an injected violation. Hygiene: removed dead `sqlite`/`rusqlite` feature, made `libsql` optional behind the `sqlite` feature, dropped unused workspace deps and the `release-full` profile, removed a dangling `readme` declaration, dropped the never-configured mold install, wired `Config.log_level` into `init_logging` (previously ignored), and excluded `target/` from markdownlint, which had been linting generated rustdoc output. Reverted my own mistaken separate `msrv` CI job after `ci_quality_ownership_test.sh` correctly rejected it: MSRV already runs inside `quality-gate` via xtask, and the audit confirms it now compiles with 1.88. Full gate green 20/20; all 11 fail-closed contract tests and all repo regression suites pass.
